blocks.text: Amino acid molecules aapas mein react kar sakte hain: aik molecule ka tezaabi -COOH group doosre ke basic -NH2 group se react karta aur paani nikal jata hai. Jab do amino acids react karte hain to product dipeptide hai: H2N-CH(R)-COOH + H2N-CH(R)-COOH -> H2N-CH(R)-CO-NH-CH(R)-COOH + H2O. Do amino acids ke darmiyan banne wala amide bond, -CO-NH-, peptide bond ya peptide link kehlata hai. Yeh condensation reaction hai, kyunke molecules ke jurne par aik chhota molecule, paani, nikalta hai.

blocks.alt: H2N-CH(R)-CO-OH + H-NH-CH(R)-COOH, pehle molecule ka OH aur doosre ka aik H narangi dabbon mein, yani paani ban kar nikalne wale atoms; minus H2O (condensation) wala teer H2N-CH(R)-CO-NH-CH(R)-COOH tak, -CO-NH- peptide link numayan. Neeche taareefein: dipeptide, tripeptide, polypeptide aur isoelectric point.
blocks.caption: Dipeptide ka banna aur peptide link (kitab ke khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Aik amino acid ka carboxyl group aur agle ka amino group apne darmiyan se paani khote hain, aur pehle ka carbon seedha doosre ke nitrogen se jur jata hai. Naya -CO-NH- jor amide group hai. Dipeptide ke aik sire par ab bhi azad -NH2 aur doosre par azad -COOH hai, is liye mazeed amino acids jur kar lambi zanjeerein bana sakte hain.

items: Tripeptide: teen amino acids ki condensation se bana compound.
Polypeptide: bohat se amino acids ki condensation se bana compound.
Isoelectric point: woh pH jis par kisi amino acid par aabi mehlool mein koi kul charge na ho.

blocks.prompt: Aspartic acid aur lysine ke R groups -CH2-COOH aur -(CH2)4-NH2 hain. Likhein (a) un ke formule, (b) zwitterions, (c) tezaab mein ions aur (d) base mein ions, aur un ke isoelectric points ka matlab samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: (a) HOOC-CH2-CH(NH2)-COOH; H2N-(CH2)4-CH(NH2)-COOH. (b) HOOC-CH2-CH(NH3+)-COO-; H2N-(CH2)4-CH(NH3+)-COO-. (c) HOOC-CH2-CH(NH3+)-COOH; H3N+-(CH2)4-CH(NH3+)-COOH. (d) -OOC-CH2-CH(NH2)-COO-; H2N-(CH2)4-CH(NH2)-COO-. Isoelectric point woh pH hai jis par har aik par kul charge nahi: aspartic acid, izafi tezaabi group ke saath, ka pI kam (taqreeban 3); lysine, izafi basic group ke saath, ka pI zyada (9.74).

items: Dipeptide (2), tripeptide (3), polypeptide (bohat se amino acids).
